title: Justice · D.A.N.C.E.
description: Colorful shapes march across dark shirts and neon walls through a hallway, a crossing and an emblem-filled finale.

performance.lyrics: Just easy as ABC, that's you make it right. To the D -A -S -C -E -D! One two three four five Stick to the B -E -A -C Get ready to ignite You were such a free white tea, catching all the lights Just easy and hazy sweet that's how we made you right To the D -A -C, speak to the V -E -A -C Just use me as ABC To the test, to the test The way you move is a mystery To the test You always have a reason to You always dancing, so where you go is for me. Ah You're the dancing, you always have all of your stuff in it. The D .A .L .C. in it, was just before ice. Skip to the B .E .H .C. get ready to embrace. You must smash a pretty white bill, searching for the light. Just sees me as a beast, that's how invasion lies. the test! You're the test! The way you know it's a mess to me! Ah Ah You always have all the respect I need. You always have all the I made. You always have all always have all of this in me Under the spotlight, neither black nor white It doesn't matter, do the dance, do the dance As strong as you might, working day and night Whatever happens, do the dance, to the dance All the others for the rest Not in a pack number wise It doesn't matter To the dance, to the dance That's all that you must What means they haven't Whatever happens So intense, so intense So what you do is unnecessary Ah To the distance You're always the voice it can be The way you move is unnecessary
